# TRU — CY2025 Q3 (ended 2025-09-30) vs CY2025 Q2 baseline and vs CY2025 Q3 guidance

**Scope note:** all comparisons below are **sequential** (Q3 vs Q2), not year over year. GAAP and non-GAAP figures are kept on their own bases. Guidance is forward-looking and is never treated as a realized result. The arithmetic is host-checked selected-source arithmetic, not a complete filing and not an economic explanation. Nothing here is a valuation or trading conclusion.

## 1. Guided vs realized (the case's core question)
Realized Q3 came in **above the Q3 guidance range on every guided line present in the extract**:

| Guided line | Guidance range | Realized Q3 | Position |
|---|---|---|---|
| Adjusted diluted EPS | 0.99–1.04 USD/share [non-GAAP] | 1.10 [non-GAAP] | above high end |
| Adjusted EBITDA | 397–411 USD_m [non-GAAP] | 425.1 [non-GAAP] | above high end |
| Revenue | 1115–1135 USD_m [GAAP] | 1169.5 [GAAP] | above high end |
| GAAP diluted EPS | 0.39–0.44 USD/share [GAAP] | 0.49 [GAAP] | above high end |

The guidance also included an attributable-income range of 78–87 USD_m; realized GAAP attributable net income was 96.6 USD_m, above that range. The guided outlook was met or beaten, not missed.

## 2. Sequential change — the two bases diverge
- **GAAP deteriorated:** attributable net income 96.6 vs 109.6 USD_m (−13.0); diluted EPS 0.49 vs 0.56 (−0.07); net income 100.2 vs 112.4 (−12.2); pretax income 150.1 vs 156.8 (−6.7).
- **Non-GAAP improved modestly:** adjusted net income 216.5 vs 213.1 USD_m (+3.4); adjusted diluted EPS 1.10 vs 1.08 (+0.02); adjusted EBITDA 425.1 vs 407.0 (+18.1).

## 3. Accounting identities (not causal drivers)
- Operating income +15.4 = revenue +29.8 − operating expenses +14.4 (exact). Revenue grew faster than operating expenses, so the operating line improved.
- Pretax income −6.7 = operating income +15.4 − nonoperating charge 22.1 (exact). The larger nonoperating charge more than offset the operating gain.
- Net income −12.2 = pretax −6.7 − tax 5.6 (residual 0.1, within rounding tolerance).
- Attributable net income −13.0 = net income −12.2 − NCI 0.8 (exact).
- Adjusted EBITDA +18.1 = EBITDA +2.1 + EBITDA adjustments +15.9 (residual 0.1, within tolerance).
- Adjusted net income +3.4 = GAAP attributable net income −13.0 + adjusted net pre-tax items +16.2 + adjusted net tax items +0.2 (exact).

These are signed bridges. They do **not** establish *why* the nonoperating charge rose or *what* the EBITDA adjustments consist of.

## 4. Supported implication
The thesis's stated review trigger — check the next filing for changes, counterevidence and missing context — is satisfied: the guided quarter was delivered above the guided ranges on both GAAP and adjusted EPS, revenue and adjusted EBITDA. The unadjusted operating base also improved sequentially (operating income +15.4 USD_m on revenue +29.8 USD_m). That is the strongest supportable positive read from these rows.

## 5. Material counterevidence
- **The adjusted improvement is largely an exclusion effect, not an operating effect.** EBITDA adjustments rose 15.9 USD_m (63.3 → 79.2) while unadjusted EBITDA rose only 2.1 USD_m (343.7 → 345.8). Roughly the whole adjusted EBITDA gain sits in the adjustment line.
- **The GAAP-to-adjusted gap widened materially.** Adjusted net pre-tax items rose 16.2 USD_m (135.6 → 151.8) while GAAP attributable net income fell 13.0 USD_m. Adjusted EPS rose 0.02 USD/share while GAAP EPS fell 0.07 USD/share — a divergence in direction, not just magnitude.
- **The GAAP decline is concentrated below the operating line.** A 22.1 USD_m larger nonoperating charge and a 5.6 USD_m larger tax charge drove the pretax and net income declines despite higher operating income.
- **Guidance-beat framing has a caveat:** the beat is measured against a range set from the same Q2 baseline; it does not by itself establish year-over-year growth, organic growth, or durability.

## 6. Missing evidence
Not present in this extract (and therefore not evidence of absence from the full filing): year-over-year comparatives; segment and organic-versus-acquisition revenue split; composition of the nonoperating charge; composition and nature (recurring vs one-time) of the EBITDA adjustments and adjusted pre-tax items; cash flow from operations and free cash flow; diluted share count and buyback activity; effective tax rate detail; margin percentages; and any Q4 or full-year guidance. Percentage-point versus percent changes cannot be assessed without revenue/margin denominators beyond the raw rows.

## 7. Research-state decision
- **Decision: `maintain`** — impact `mixed`. Thesis `th_4294c26588a54297aaae` stays **active** at conviction **3**; no assumption or invalidation condition was triggered by these selected rows, and no valuation conclusion is established.
- **Persisted review:** `tr_72184fcea56b4a1d86b2`, thesis version 1 → **2**, linked to alert `fa_9df2ca47c49b4d888cbd` and to both source records (`HOLDOUT-V4-TRU-EVENT`, sha256 `94d2ed53…c515ef`; `HOLDOUT-V4-TRU-BASELINE`, sha256 `b4a0372c…7e99e5`). Next review set to 2026-11-30.
- **Alert:** `fa_9df2ca47c49b4d888cbd` acknowledged (version 1 → 2).
- **Block verification:** because the decision was `maintain` and not `needs_review`, no hold was created — re-read of the thesis confirms `decision_hold: false`, `actionability: "available"`, `decision_hold_alert_id: null`, status `active`, conviction `3`. The needs_review blocking path was therefore not exercised; had it been, the tool's contract preserves status and conviction and blocks downstream decisions.
- **No trades placed.**
